SATOM 4.4.0

Every product's cached objects in the no-SQL query builder, 316 joined plugin datasets by ADOM from one button with dataset and table browsers, and SATOM Builder working across every ADOM with one Global token; a lock deadlock that froze tables after the query builder opened is fixed.

👤 ForOperatorAdministratorAdvanced user
On this page
  • In short
  • Added
  • Fixed
  • Upgrading

Released: 2026-10-26 · All releases

In short#

FortiGate, FortiADC, FortiAnalyzer and FortiAuthenticator objects now reach the no-SQL query builder, grouped per product, and one button turns the device cache into hundreds of ready joined datasets for plugins — which FortiGate rules use an address, a virtual server with its pool members, users with their groups. SATOM Builder sees every ADOM's datasets through one Global token and installs a package in the right ADOM. Everything in 4.3.0 and earlier applies.

Added#

  • Every product in the query builder. Every object type the device cache holds (603 on the lab fleet) is a table of the builder behind reports, plugin datasets and script lookups, grouped as FortiGate · Firewall policies, FortiADC · Server load balancing… with a description. Joins never cross devices: a list reaches its parent by parent_id, a field that names another object joins it through <field>_ref. Browse tables opens them all in a searchable browser. → Database tools.
  • Generate joined datasets in Administrator → System → Database → Plugin datasets: every list with its parent, every reference resolved and the common chains (FortiGate rules by address, group, service or incoming interface; FortiADC pool members; FortiAuthenticator users and RADIUS clients), published in their product's ADOM. 316 on the lab fleet. It never overwrites an existing key. → Build a plugin dataset.
  • Browse the N datasets: every dataset of the server — built-in, device objects, administrator — by ADOM and category, with search and the key to copy. The tab now lists administrator datasets grouped by ADOM.
  • SATOM Builder across ADOMs. Every /api/v1/builder/* call takes ?adom=: with a Global token it is the ADOM the call runs in (datasets, checks, where an import installs), among Global and the ADOMs the token's owner may enter; a token bound to one ADOM never widens (403). The library and target add reach and elsewhere (the datasets of the owner's other ADOMs, names only), so an AI author is told "this dataset lives in ADOM X", never "it does not exist". → API.
  • Plugin Studio links to New plugin dataset and the Plugin datasets list.

Fixed#

  • A Builder package that reads a dataset of another ADOM is refused (rule view.datasets_adom) instead of installing a view that shows nothing; a console import warns.
  • Tables (app_ids, waf_artifact_ref) stopped answering for minutes after the query builder or the Database page opened: a lock deadlock between the relational model's row counts and a schema fix-up every timer ran at boot. Row counts now run in their own short transaction and the boot issues no DDL in steady state.
  • Query-builder joins between two long FortiWeb deep-layer tables failed (DuplicateAlias); Related tables offered every table of every product.
  • Show as list on the relational model opened below the fold and looked dead; it now swaps the diagram for the list.
  • A Plugin Studio diagram with the wrong shape (for example step params written as a list) is a named problem (app.definition), not a crash.

Upgrading#

Apply the update package as usual (Settings → System → Software Update, or satom execute update package); it accepts servers on 3.3.3 or newer. No schema migration. The joined datasets are not created by the upgrade: an administrator with studio.plugin_studio clicks Generate joined datasets once. To use SATOM Builder across ADOMs, give it a token created in the Global ADOM; a token bound to one ADOM keeps working there.
